summary: Shen Feizhi recovers in a pocket dimension managed by A11 and C2 after his shuttle self-destructed. He learns he is the rightful 'Child of Destiny' whose identity was usurped. After his physical recovery, he accesses his memories, revealing his tragic past: he was a neglected child saved by Gu Suizhou's parents (Lin Zizhuo and Gu Lang). He made a death-vow to protect Gu Suizhou, leading to his long-term, patient care for the boy, which explains his past behavior toward Gu Suizhou.
